answer_text: NO_PROPOSAL_CHOSEN means the peers could not agree on a common IPsec transform (phase 1/phase 2) during IKE negotiation, which is reported as an error in the tunnel timeline. To see exactly which parameters were being proposed, open the IPsec site in CMA, go to Timeline, and download the CSV to review the transforms that were proposed. You can also use the built-in packet capture tool for IPsec to inspect the IKE negotiations and identify the precise P1/P2 transforms that were being proposed, which helps pinpoint where the mismatch occurs.
